Metrics.Name: graph2otel.annotation.degraded
Metrics.Description: Whether the most recent Grafana annotation write failed and has not been recovered by a later success.

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.annotation.dropped
Metrics.Description: Annotations that did not reach Grafana since process start, by bounded reason (duplicate is the steady state on a state-shaped source, not a fault).

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.annotation.published
Metrics.Description: Annotations accepted by the Grafana annotations API since process start.
